scope: Only new apiObservationS3, composed with the accepted read helper and original TF1/port in restricted inert fixtures. Every existing host function, port and lib is unchanged.
behavior: Ten named IO helper boundaries check both actual return and throw before later helpers or validation. Exact fatal/local stop outranks operation errors; valid post-checks preserve ordinary and falsy throws.
Legacy short-circuit ordering is preserved. Config files use the accepted read helper with the same work/window and without a redundant sample pair.
The environ read retains its separate 1048576-byte cap and does not add cumulative file/byte charges. A late invalid buffer produces Clock stop before the legacy cap error.
Private db/port/identity result shape is preserved only inside the caller interface; reports contain fixed assertions, codes and counters, not private values.
Final checkpoint precedes result return. Pure validation/hash throws do not add a terminal sample or claim precedence over unobserved later faults.
Prior cleanup failure refuses before IO; work counters are not reset. Identity/collect/S3 still use the old route.

independent.baselineQualification: One API opening, twenty observation IO pre/post samples, eleven accepted read-helper samples and one final publication sample.
independent.harnessCorrection: An initial nested sample expectation was corrected to measure no added terminal sample; the original failed harness result is retained.

notRun: Exhaustive parser/predicate/schema/extreme-value permutations and full prior regression suites.
Identity/collect/S3 integration, native process/environment/filesystem/clock behavior, producer provenance, actual settlement, RD7, approved caps, broad CI and production.
limitations: Nested helper internals remain uninstrumented and unqualified; this is helper-boundary evidence.
Original process/epoch/environment association remains unchanged and unqualified. Private-return compatibility does not authorize logging.
No deployment, READY, GO or rollback authority. REA remains paused.
